broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: LBPs的临床应用现状与挑战
broader_review_uses.material: CJRB-101作为一种源自食物（泡菜）的口服胶囊，相比粪菌移植（FMT）具有更好的安全性和便利性，但未发现稳健的患者选择工具。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论LBPs相较于FMT的优势（易用性、安全性）及其当前局限性（缺乏精准患者分层标准，疗效个体差异大）。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 实体瘤中ICI耐药的异质性
broader_review_uses.material: ICI难治性NSCLC、HNSCC和黑色素瘤患者对CJRB-101联合治疗反应不佳，而ICI初治NSCLC反应较好。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于佐证ICI耐药机制的复杂性，提示单纯补充益生菌可能不足以逆转已形成的复杂耐药网络，特别是在既往接受过多次ICI治疗的患者中。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限Phase I早期数据，样本量小，缺乏随机对照比较（虽提及KEYNOTE-024历史数据作为数值对比，但非直接头对头试验）。疗效结论仅限于特定PD-L1高表达人群。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了CJRB-101联合帕博利珠单抗在ICI初治NSCLC患者中的临床疗效数据（ORR 58%, PFS 9个月），证明特定益生菌干预可改善ICI疗效。同时指出在ICI难治患者中疗效微弱（ORR 5%），提示菌群调节可能对原发耐药更有效，或对继发耐药效果有限。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于论证肠道微生物组调节对ICI疗效的正面影响，特别是作为一线治疗的潜在增敏策略。可用于对比不同人群（初治vs难治）的响应差异，探讨菌群干预的最佳时机。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制主要在动物模型（PDX和小鼠）和体外实验中证实。人体内的空间和时间动态（如肠道菌群变化如何精确转化为肿瘤内免疫改变）仍主要基于相关性分析和推测，需结合其他研究验证其在人类体内的普遍性。
facet_contributions.contribution: 详细描述了CJRB-101的作用机制：通过TLR4受体识别细菌细胞膜组分，诱导肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）从M2向M1型极化（伴随CXCL9/10分泌），进而招募和活化CD8+ T细胞（增加Tcm比例和细胞毒性分子）。此外，还涉及肠道局部免疫激活（NK细胞、巨噬细胞）向全身及肿瘤部位的传导。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于解释肠道菌群如何通过免疫细胞重编程（特别是髓系细胞）间接增强ICI疗效。可作为“巨噬细胞极化”和“T细胞再活化”机制的具体实例。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 微生物组数据为探索性终点，未建立严格的因果预测模型。不同种族/饮食背景下的菌群响应可能存在差异，文中提到这是挑战。
facet_contributions.contribution: 展示了CJRB-101对肠道微生物组的实际调节效果：增加L. mesenteroides丰度，提高整体微生物多样性，并富集产丁酸菌。在ICI难治患者中，发现临床获益者的基线微生物多样性较低。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于说明LBPs对肠道生态系统的重塑能力，以及微生物多样性与ICI疗效之间的潜在关联。可为综述提供关于“菌群组成变化”作为药效学指标的证据。

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于“特定益生菌株调节肠道微生物组以增强ICI疗效”的直接实证素材。它不仅报告了临床I期的安全性和初步疗效数据（特别是在ICI初治NSCLC中的积极结果），还详细阐述了从肠道到肿瘤的免疫协调机制（巨噬细胞极化和T细胞活化）。对于综述而言，此文是讨论“活体生物制品（LBPs）作为ICI增敏剂”这一策略的重要案例，特别是提供了关于机制路径（TLR4/M1极化）和临床响应异质性（初治vs难治）的具体细节。
scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究的临床数据来自Phase I试验，样本量有限（n=42），且大部分为NSCLC患者，HNSCC和黑色素瘤数据极少，不能代表所有实体瘤。
疗效数据主要基于ICI初治、PD-L1>50%的亚组，推广至低PD-L1表达或ICI难治人群需谨慎。
机制研究中使用的TLR4抑制和细胞膜组分实验主要在体外和动物模型中进行，人体内的确切靶点和通路仍需更多临床验证。
微生物组分析为观察性探索，未证明特定的菌群变化直接导致临床获益，仅显示相关性。

study_summary_A.approach: 研究采用“临床前机制验证+早期临床转化”的两阶段设计。临床前部分：利用C3PQ同系小鼠模型和人源化NSCLC PDX模型，结合单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）、流式细胞术、多重免疫组化（mIHC）及细胞耗竭实验，解析CJRB-101对巨噬细胞极化（M2至M1）和T细胞活化的影响，并通过体外骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）实验鉴定活性成分（细胞膜组分CM）及受体（TLR4）。临床部分：开展I期临床试验，评估CJRB-101不同剂量联合帕博利珠单抗的安全性（DLT/AE）和初步疗效（ORR/DCR/PFS）。同时收集患者粪便样本进行宏基因组/16S测序以监测微生物组变化，以及血液样本进行药代动力学和免疫标志物分析。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了CJRB-101（一种源自发酵食品的活体生物制品）联合帕博利珠单抗在ICI初治NSCLC中的早期临床数据，显示其具有改善响应率的潜力且安全性良好。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 样本量较小（尤其是各亚组），随访时间较短（中位8.9-15.6个月），无法确立长期生存获益或普适性。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 阐明了CJRB-101通过TLR4依赖性途径诱导巨噬细胞M2-M1极化并增强T细胞细胞毒性的具体免疫机制，连接了肠道菌群与肿瘤微环境的相互作用。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 机制主要在动物模型和体外实验中验证，人体内的确切因果链条（如特定代谢物或抗原如何跨屏障起作用）尚需更多证据支持。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 揭示了ICI难治患者基线微生物特征与临床获益的相关性，以及CJRB-101对菌群多样性的调节作用。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 未能识别出稳健的患者选择生物标志物；在ICI难治队列中疗效不显著，限制了其作为普遍增敏剂的结论。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 确认了CJRB-101的活性成分可能为其细胞膜组分（CM），为后续开发更简化的生物制剂提供了方向。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 作者指出纯化及进一步机制研究仍在进行中，当前仅基于粗提物或完整菌株的观察。

key_findings.conditions: C3PQ同系小鼠模型及人源化NSCLC PDX模型
key_findings.finding: CJRB-101联合抗PD-1显著抑制肿瘤生长，效果优于单用抗PD-1。机制上，CJRB-101诱导巨噬细胞从M2向表达CXCL9/CXCL10的M1表型极化，并促进中央记忆T细胞（Tcm）扩增及细胞毒性分子（GZMB, IFN-γ）表达。该过程依赖CD8+ T细胞、巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞，且由CJRB-101的细胞膜组分通过TLR4通路介导。
联合治疗显示出积极的抗肿瘤反应，ORR为58%，DCR为75%，中位PFS为9个月（随访15.6个月）。
疗效有限，ORR仅为5%，DCR为41%，中位PFS为1.8个月。基线时临床获益者微生物多样性低于无获益者。

key_findings.conditions: 所有入组患者 (n=42) 的肠道微生物组分析
key_findings.finding: CJRB-101给药后，粪便中L. mesenteroides丰度显著增加，整体微生物多样性（Shannon指数等）在第3周和第8周有所提升，伴产丁酸菌属（如Faecalibacterium）富集。外周血中免疫激活基因（如CCL5, CCL21）表达上调。
未发生剂量限制性毒性（DLT），无3级及以上治疗相关不良事件，主要AE为轻度AST/ALT升高和腹泻。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 针对大多数晚期实体瘤患者对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）存在原发或继发耐药的问题，探究通过调节肠道微生物组（特别是使用特定益生菌株CJRB-101）来重塑肿瘤微环境（TME），从而增强ICI疗效的可行性、安全性及其潜在的免疫学机制。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 本研究涵盖临床前机制探索（小鼠同系模型、人源化NSCLC PDX模型、体外巨噬细胞/T细胞共培养）与一项多中心、开放标签的I期临床试验。研究对象为晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）、头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）和黑色素瘤患者，分为免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）初治和ICI难治两组。活体生物制品CJRB-101（含Leuconostoc mesenteroides新菌株）与帕博利珠单抗联合使用。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 该研究旨在评估口服活体生物制品CJRB-101联合帕博利珠单抗在实体瘤中的安全性、初步疗效及作用机制。临床前部分通过多种模型证实CJRB-101能诱导肿瘤微环境中M2型巨噬细胞向M1型极化，并增强CD8+ T细胞的活化与细胞毒性，且该效应依赖于TLR4信号通路。临床试验部分纳入42名患者，主要终点为剂量限制性毒性（DLT）。结果显示联合方案耐受性良好，无3级以上治疗相关不良事件。在PD-L1>50%的ICI初治转移性NSCLC患者中，观察到较高的客观缓解率（ORR 58%）和疾病控制率（DCR 75%），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为9个月；而在ICI难治人群中疗效有限。探索性分析显示CJRB-101给药后肠道微生物多样性增加，特定菌群丰度改变，并与外周血免疫激活标志物上调相关。

supplement_gap_material.auxiliary_material: Detailed mechanistic validation of the M2-to-M1 macrophage repolarization and TLR4-dependent pathway is provided from preclinical models (humanized PDX, syngeneic mice, in vitro BMDM assays), not directly from patient samples. The study also reports clinical efficacy outcomes (ORR 58% in ICI-naïve NSCLC) and safety data, which contextualize the immune findings but do not themselves validate the mechanism. The observation that baseline microbial diversity was lower in clinical benefit responders (ICI-refractory) is a correlational finding distinct from the interventional mechanism.
supplement_gap_material.outline_action: Cite this study as the primary recent human evidence linking a specific strain (CJRB-101) to immune pharmacodynamics in ICI-treated solid tumors. Use the preclinical data to describe the proposed mechanism (TLR4/M1 polarization) while explicitly qualifying that the human data supports this via correlative immune marker changes (gene expression, flow cytometry) rather than direct mechanistic proof in patients. Highlight the distinction between strain engraftment confirmation and the associative nature of the immune readouts in the Phase I design.
supplement_gap_material.remaining_gap: While the study links the specific strain to immune changes in patients, the human data primarily demonstrates pharmacodynamic associations (pre-post treatment changes or responder vs. non-responder comparisons) rather than causal validation of the specific immune mechanism (e.g., proving TLR4-mediated DC maturation) within the human patients themselves. The deep mechanistic pathway (TLR4, M2-M1 repolarization) is validated in preclinical models, leaving the human mechanistic validation at the level of immune marker modulation consistent with the hypothesis but not experimentally proven beyond correlation in the clinical cohort.
supplement_gap_material.useful_material: This study is a prospective, first-in-human Phase I trial (NCT05877430, 2023-2025) evaluating a specific bacterial strain, CJRB-101 (Leuconostoc mesenteroides), combined with pembrolizumab in solid tumor patients (NSCLC, HNSCC, melanoma). It meets the temporal and population criteria. The authors confirmed strain-specific engraftment via stool metagenomics (increased L. mesenteroides abundance) and measured immune mechanisms in patients, including upregulation of immune activation genes (CCL5, TLR9, CD3E) in on-treatment samples, reduction of PD-1+TIM-3+ T cells and PMN-MDSCs in peripheral blood, and spatial profiling showing increased GZB+CD8+ T cells in tumor tissue. These data link the specific strain administration to measured immune pharmacodynamic effects in ICI-treated patients.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 背景与概念：介绍了Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs)作为一种比FMT更可控、可标准化的肠道微生物调节策略。
broader_review_uses.material: CJRB-101是一种源自泡菜的新型肠膜明串珠菌菌株，制成口服胶囊。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于综述中介绍肠道微生物干预手段的演进，从FMT到单一菌株LBP的比较。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 反例/局限性：展示了即使有明确的机制和安全性，LBP在ICI-refractory患者中也可能无效。
broader_review_uses.material: ICI-refractory NSCLC患者ORR仅5%，PFS 1.8个月；HNSCC和黑色素瘤患者均出现疾病进展。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论当前LBP疗法的挑战，即并非所有耐药患者都能从中受益，提示需要更精准的患者筛选策略。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 实践知识：提供了LBP联合ICI的安全性概况。
broader_review_uses.material: 无DLT，无>3级TRAE，常见副作用为轻度AST/ALT升高和腹泻。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于评估LBP作为辅助治疗的安全性特征，支持其临床开发的可行性。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限Phase I阶段数据，样本量小，随访时间短。结论仅适用于该特定菌株和组合，不能外推至其他益生菌或ICI药物。未解决ICI-refractory患者的耐药机制问题。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了CJRB-101联合帕博利珠单抗在晚期实体瘤中的临床疗效数据。在ICI-naïve、PD-L1>50%的转移性NSCLC患者中，ORR达到58%，中位PFS为9个月，高于历史对照（KEYNOTE-024中的44.8%）。但在ICI-refractory患者中获益微弱（ORR 5%）。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于论证特定LBP在特定患者亚群（ICI-naïve, high PD-L1）中可能提升ICI疗效，同时指出其在耐药人群中的局限性。可作为“LBP增强ICI疗效”的证据之一，并对比不同人群的反应差异。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制主要在动物模型和体外实验中确立，临床样本中的空间和时间动态关联虽有多重IHC支持，但因果推断仍需谨慎。TLR4的作用是基于抑制实验，需确认其在人体中的普遍性。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了CJRB-101调节肿瘤免疫微环境的具体分子和细胞机制：1) 通过TLR4依赖途径诱导巨噬细胞从M2向M1表型重极化，上调CXCL9/CXCL10；2) 促进肠道固有层先天免疫激活，进而引发系统性CD8+ T细胞扩增及肿瘤内浸润；3) 增加中央记忆T细胞（Tcm）比例和细胞毒性分子表达。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 直接回答“机制是什么”的子问题。可用于解释肠道微生物如何通过远端效应（gut-tumor axis）改变TME，特别是巨噬细胞极化和T细胞活化这两个关键节点。可与其他研究对比不同的免疫调节路径（如仅依赖Treg减少 vs 主动招募效应细胞）。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了CJRB-101作为LBP联合PD-1抑制剂在早期临床阶段的安全性和初步疗效数据，特别是在ICI-naïve NSCLC中的潜在获益。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 样本量较小（仅42人），且绝大多数为NSCLC患者，缺乏其他癌种的足够统计效力。随访时间较短（中位8.9-15.6个月），长期生存数据不足。未能识别出稳健的患者选择生物标志物。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 阐明了CJRB-101通过TLR4依赖途径诱导巨噬细胞M2-to-M1重极化并增强T细胞毒性的具体免疫机制。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 机制研究主要基于小鼠模型和体外实验，虽然与临床药效关联，但人体内的确切因果链条需更多临床样本验证。作者声称的机制解释归因于本研究，尚未被独立证实。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 记录了CJRB-101对肠道菌群组成的具体影响（增加目标菌及多样性）。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代具体的统计学校正方法对多重比较的影响，也未提供详细的菌群-临床结局相关性分析的完整数据，难以确定菌群变化是否为疗效的直接预测因子。

key_findings.conditions: C3PQ同基因小鼠模型及4个NSCLC人源化PDX模型
key_findings.finding: CJRB-101联合抗PD-1抗体显著抑制肿瘤生长，优于单用抗PD-1。机制涉及CD8+ T细胞、巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞的协同作用；CJRB-101诱导M2向M1巨噬细胞重极化（表达CXCL9/10），并增加中央记忆T细胞（Tcm）和细胞毒性T细胞浸润。

key_findings.conditions: 42名晚期实体瘤患者的I期临床试验（主要为转移性NSCLC）
key_findings.finding: 未观察到剂量限制性毒性（DLT），无>3级治疗相关不良事件。在ICI-naïve且PD-L1>50%的NSCLC患者（n=12）中，ORR为58%，中位PFS为9个月；而在ICI-refractory NSCLC患者（n=22）中，ORR仅为5%，中位PFS为1.8个月。

key_findings.conditions: 体外BMDM实验及体内TLR4抑制实验
key_findings.finding: CJRB-101的细胞膜（CM）组分可直接诱导巨噬细胞M1极化，该过程依赖于TLR4信号通路。

key_findings.conditions: 患者粪便宏基因组学分析
key_findings.finding: CJRB-101给药后，粪便中Leuconostoc mesenteroides丰度增加，微生物多样性提高，且丁酸产生菌富集。ICI-refractory患者中，临床获益者基线微生物多样性较低。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 针对大多数晚期实体瘤患者对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）无响应或产生耐药的问题，探究通过口服活体生物制剂CJRB-101调节肠道微生物群以改善肿瘤微环境免疫状态、增强ICI疗效的可行性及其生物学机制。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 研究对象为晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）、头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）和黑色素瘤患者，以及人源化NSCLC患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型和同基因小鼠模型。研究情境涵盖临床I期试验（ICI-naïve和ICI-refractory人群）及前临床机制探索（体外巨噬细胞重极化、体内免疫耗竭实验）。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究旨在评估活体生物制剂CJRB-101（一种来源于肠膜明串珠菌的新菌株）联合帕博利珠单抗治疗晚期实体瘤的安全性和初步疗效，并阐明其调节肿瘤微环境（TME）的机制。研究首先通过小鼠模型和PDX模型验证了CJRB-101能诱导M2型向M1型巨噬细胞重极化并增强CD8+ T细胞活性，从而增强抗肿瘤效果。随后开展了一项多中心、开放标签的I期临床试验，纳入42名患者，主要评估剂量限制性毒性（DLT）和不良事件（AEs），次要终点包括客观缓解率（ORR）和无进展生存期（PFS）。结果显示该组合在ICI-naïve且PD-L1>50%的转移性NSCLC患者中显示出令人鼓舞的反应率（ORR 58%），而在ICI-refractory患者中获益有限。机制上，CJRB-101通过其细胞膜组分激活TLR4信号通路，驱动巨噬细胞向产生CXCL9/CXCL10的M1表型转化，进而促进T细胞浸润和活化。

supplement_gap_material.auxiliary_material: The study provides detailed preclinical mechanistic data showing CJRB-101 induces M2-to-M1 macrophage repolarization via TLR4 signaling and increases CXCL9/CXCL10, which supports the biological plausibility of the human findings. It also reports clinical efficacy outcomes (ORR 58% in ICI-naïve NSCLC) and safety data (no DLTs), which contextualize the feasibility of strain-specific interventions. The text notes limitations such as the single-arm design, small sample size for mechanistic endpoints, and the fact that ICI-refractory cohorts showed minimal benefit, indicating the mechanism may depend on patient selection.
supplement_gap_material.outline_action: Cite this study as the primary recent human evidence linking a specific strain (L. mesenteroides CJRB-101) to immune modulation (T-cell activation, myeloid gene upregulation) in ICI-treated solid tumor patients. Use the preclinical data to explain the proposed mechanism (TLR4/M1 repolarization) while explicitly noting that human validation is based on pharmacodynamic markers and spatial profiling rather than direct pathway confirmation. Highlight the distinction between ICI-naïve and ICI-refractory responses to discuss patient selection criteria for future mechanistic studies. Recommend searching for controlled trials or studies with direct mechanistic biopsies (e.g., TLR4 staining) to further close the 'beyond correlation' gap.
supplement_gap_material.remaining_gap: The human evidence remains primarily pharmacodynamic and associational (pre-post treatment changes in a single-arm trial) rather than definitive causal validation of the specific mechanism (e.g., TLR4 pathway activation by the strain) within patient tissues. The success criterion requires linking strain to mechanism in ICI-treated patients; while this study links strain administration to immune changes, it does not fully prove the strain-specific mechanism in humans 'beyond correlation' without a control arm or direct mechanistic readouts (e.g., TLR4 activation status) in patient samples. Additionally, the mechanistic validation is strongest in the preclinical setting, leaving some uncertainty about the translation of the exact pathway to humans.
supplement_gap_material.useful_material: This study is a prospective, first-in-human Phase I trial (NCT05877430) conducted between 2023 and 2025, evaluating a specific bacterial strain (CJRB-101, Leuconostoc mesenteroides) combined with pembrolizumab in solid tumor patients (NSCLC, HNSCC, melanoma). It directly addresses the gap by linking the administration and stool enrichment of this specific strain to measured immune mechanisms in ICI-treated patients. In human patients, the study reports pharmacodynamic effects including on-treatment upregulation of immune activation genes (CCL5, TLR9, CD3E) in blood/tumor, reduced PD-1+TIM-3+ T cells in PBMCs, and multiplex IHC evidence of enhanced GZB+CD8+ T-cell infiltration in tumor tissue from a responding patient. Stool metagenomics confirmed strain-specific engraftment. While the causal mechanism (TLR4-dependent M2-to-M1 repolarization) was validated in preclinical models (PDX, syngeneic mice, in vitro BMDM), the human data provides prospective interventional evidence linking the strain to immune modulation, though it lacks a placebo-controlled arm to fully isolate the strain's mechanistic contribution from the ICI backbone in humans.

broader_review_uses.material: Discussion of Lachnospiraceae, Akkermansia, and Actinobacteria associations with ICI response in lymphoma patients.
broader_review_uses.purpose: To compare microbial signatures associated with ICI success/failure in hematological cancers against those reported for solid tumors, potentially identifying universal vs. cancer-specific biomarkers.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Does not provide direct evidence for ICI efficacy in solid tumors; only contrasts with hematological findings.
facet_contributions.contribution: Explicitly delineates the scope of hematological malignancies, noting that findings in solid tumors (like epithelial tumors) may not translate to lymphomas or leukemias. This helps define exclusion criteria or boundary conditions for the user's review on solid tumors.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Use to justify excluding hematological studies or to highlight differences in microbiome-tumor interactions between cancer types.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Mechanisms described are largely synthesized from various sources; direct causal proof in human solid tumor patients is not established here.
facet_contributions.contribution: Details specific immune modulation mechanisms involving the microbiome, such as the IL-12-dependent pathway mediated by Akkermansia muciniphila and the role of SCFAs (butyrate) in immune regulation. It also describes how bacteria interact with immune cells via Toll-Like Receptors (TLRs).
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Provide mechanistic examples of microbiome-immune interaction that may be conserved or distinct across cancer types. Useful for discussing common biological pathways (e.g., TLR signaling, SCFA effects) regardless of tumor type.

review_planning_B.planning_summary: This review provides critical context for understanding why gut microbiome data from hematological malignancies should be excluded or treated separately when investigating immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in solid tumors. It explicitly states that mechanisms observed in solid tumors (e.g., certain metabolic pathways) do not necessarily apply to hematological cancers. However, it offers valuable comparative material on ICI mechanisms (IL-12 pathway, Akkermansia role) and detailed descriptions of microbiome shifts during immunotherapy, which can serve as a contrast or control group in a broader review comparing different cancer types.
scope_interpretation_cautions: This paper focuses exclusively on hematological malignancies. Do not extrapolate its findings on ICI efficacy or mechanisms directly to solid tumors without verifying cross-cancer validity.
The review is narrative; avoid treating its summaries as definitive meta-analytic results. Many cited studies are small-scale or preclinical.
Note the explicit distinction made in the text between solid tumor mechanisms (e.g., cisplatin) and hematological ones; assuming equivalence is incorrect.

study_summary_A.approach: A narrative literature review conducted using searches in PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Scopus. The authors selected clinical and preclinical studies, randomized controlled trials, cohort studies, systematic reviews, and relevant narrative reviews focusing on the relationship between gut microbiome and cancer therapies in hematological contexts. The synthesis is organized by treatment modalities (chemotherapy, HSCT, immunotherapy, CAR-T) and mechanisms (drug metabolism, immune modulation, toxicity).

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Provides a comprehensive synthesis of microbiome-treatment interactions specifically for hematological malignancies, distinguishing them from solid tumor findings.
contribution_and_limits.limits: As a narrative review, it does not perform a meta-analysis or systematic quantitative evaluation; findings are based on selected studies which may introduce selection bias.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Identifies specific bacterial taxa and metabolites (e.g., SCFAs, TMAO) as potential biomarkers for treatment response and toxicity.
contribution_and_limits.limits: Many mechanistic insights are derived from murine models or small human cohorts; causal relationships in humans are often observational and require further validation.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Highlights the bidirectional relationship between drugs and microbiome (pharmacomicrobiology), including drug inactivation by bacteria.
contribution_and_limits.limits: The review notes that some mechanisms (e.g., cisplatin toxicity via 3-methylxanthine) were observed in epithelial tumors but not lymphomas, limiting generalizability across all hematological cancers.

key_findings.finding: Higher levels of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii in the first post-transplant week were associated with a need for a 50% higher Tacrolimus dose due to bacterial inactivation of the drug.

CTX promotes translocation of Gram-positive bacteria (Lactobacillus johnsonii, Enterococcus hirae) to lymphoid organs, enhancing TH1/TH17 responses and antitumor immunity; antibiotic use blocks this effect and reduces efficacy.

study_summary_A.work_summary: 本文是一篇综述，系统探讨了肠道微生物代谢产物在结直肠癌（CRC）发病机制及免疫治疗中的双重作用。文章首先梳理了与CRC发生发展相关的特定病原菌和益生菌及其产生的关键代谢物（如短链脂肪酸、次级胆汁酸、氨基酸衍生物等），详细阐述了这些代谢物如何通过激活致癌信号通路、诱导慢性炎症、介导免疫逃逸以及调控宿主表观遗传来影响肿瘤进程。随后，文章重点分析了靶向微生物代谢物的干预策略，包括益生菌、益生元、工程菌及其代谢物作为免疫佐剂增强ICB疗效的机制，并评估了基于微生物组成和代谢谱的非侵入性诊断标志物的临床潜力。最后，讨论了多组学与人工智能整合在精准医疗中的应用前景及当前面临的转化挑战。

study_summary_A.approach: A scoping review methodology was used to select and synthesize preclinical and human studies. Studies were included if they assessed sleep/circadian disruption, gut microbiome outcomes, and at least one functional biomarker (hormones, metabolites, neurotransmitters, or inflammation). Data were stratified by sample type (plasma/serum, GI tissue, brain tissue, etc.) and categorized using hierarchical databases (HMDB, KEGG, LIPID MAPS). Results were grouped by intervention type (sleep disruption vs. circadian disruption) and biomarker class to identify convergent functional signatures.

contribution_and_limits.limits: Most included studies are observational or cross-sectional, limiting causal inference. Human data are sparse and heterogeneous. The review does not establish direct causal mediation by specific taxa but rather associations. Specific mechanisms like kynurenine pathway metabolites were noted as under-measured in current literature.

key_findings.finding: Increased HPA axis activity (CRH, ACTH, cortisol/corticosterone); decreased GABA, serotonin, melatonin; increased pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α); decreased fecal SCFAs; downregulated amino acid and lipid metabolism; upregulated glycolysis/TCA cycle.
Increased primary bile acids and decreased secondary bile acids; increased LPS biosynthesis and bacterial virulence pathways; localized GI inflammation (IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-17).

Limited data; generally paralleled preclinical inflammatory responses (increased IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, LPS); decreased fecal SCFAs associated with poor sleep quality/short duration; conflicting cortisol responses compared to rodents.

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: To synthesize evidence on how sleep and circadian disruption affect not just the composition but the functional capacity of the gut microbiome and host physiology, specifically identifying mechanistic pathways (neuroendocrine, immune, metabolic) that link these systems.
study_summary_A.research_scope: The review synthesizes preclinical (rodent) and translational (human) studies examining the bidirectional relationship between sleep/circadian disruption and the gut microbiome. It focuses on functional biomarkers—hormones, neurotransmitters, inflammatory mediators, metabolites, and functional genes—in addition to microbial composition.
study_summary_A.work_summary: This scoping review (Part II of a series) integrates findings from 83 studies (59 rodent, 24 human) that measured functional biomarkers alongside sleep/microbiome outcomes. It identifies consistent mechanistic links between sleep disruption and host homeostasis changes mediated by the microbiome, including HPA axis activation, altered bile acid metabolism, inflammation-related shifts, and disrupted tryptophan pathways. The authors argue that while taxonomic responses vary, functional signatures converge, suggesting metabolic and signaling biomarkers are more stable indicators of microbiome involvement in sleep pathology than composition alone.

chapter.scope: 肠道微生物群对实体瘤 ICI 疗效的调节作用具有坚实的生物学合理性，但现有证据呈现显著的层级分化：观察性关联（如抗生素暴露、特定菌属富集）提供了稳健的效应信号，而干预性证据（如 FMT、活体生物制品）仍局限于早期试验且伴随定植不确定性与安全性考量；跨队列生物标志物难以复现主要源于方法学异质性（测序平台、生信流程、样本采集时序）与生物学情境依赖性（肿瘤类型、宿主基线、给药时序）。系统性检索确认当前无已完成的大规模纯微生物干预 III 期 RCT，TACITO 等试验为 II 期设计且未正式达到主要终点。未来转化需从"单一物种分类学"转向"功能代谢通路"，并依托标准化多中心 RCT 与空间多组学技术，以建立可重复的预测模型与精准干预路径。

substantive_threads: 观察性数据确立了微生物扰动（尤其是抗生素暴露）与 ICI 疗效下降的强关联，而干预性证据虽显示概念验证潜力，但受限于早期试验设计、样本量及安全性考量，证据层级存在显著分化。系统性检索确认当前无已完成的大规模纯微生物干预 III 期 RCT。
跨队列生物标志物难以复现主要源于方法学异质性（测序平台、生信管道、样本采集时序）与生物学情境依赖性（肿瘤类型、宿主基线、给药时序），导致单一分类学特征无法作为普适性预测工具。
机制转化面临核心瓶颈：人体肿瘤微环境（TME）内微生物代谢物（如肌苷、SCFAs）的直接定量数据严重缺失，现有证据多依赖粪便/血浆间接推断或动物模型外推，阻碍了因果通路的临床确证。
未来研究需从描述性分类学转向功能导向的多组学整合，依托标准化前瞻性队列、严格控制的随机干预试验及 AI 驱动的生物信息学 pipeline，以建立可重复的预测模型并推动精准微生物疗法落地。

units.substantive_point: 观察性数据确立了微生物扰动（尤其是抗生素暴露）与 ICI 疗效下降的强关联，而干预性证据虽显示概念验证潜力，但受限于早期试验设计、样本量及安全性考量，证据层级存在显著分化。系统性检索确认当前无已完成的大规模纯微生物干预 III 期 RCT。
units.synthesis: 观察性队列提供了一致的关联信号，提示抗生素使用是 ICI 预后不良的独立预测因子；然而，干预性证据目前仅限于 II 期概念验证阶段，阳性结果（如 FMT-LUMINate）与阴性结果（如 MITRIC）并存，表明疗效高度依赖患者选择、基线生态状态及给药时机。当前证据尚不足以将 FMT 或益生菌确立为标准护理，临床管理需基于证据等级保持审慎。
units.transition: 既然观察性信号稳健但干预效果波动，必须追问为何不同研究间生物标志物难以复现，从而引出对方法学与生物学异质性的深入剖析。

units.synthesis: 方法学层面，测序深度、OTU 聚类算法与参考数据库的差异直接导致丰度估计偏差；生物学层面，肿瘤原发部位（如结直肠 vs 肺）、分子分型（MSI 状态）及宿主用药史（如化疗时序、PPI 暴露）深刻重塑局部与全身微生物景观。同一代谢物或菌属在不同 ICI 靶点或肿瘤背景下可能呈现促炎或抗炎的双向效应，证明"一刀切"的分类学生物标志物缺乏稳健性。
units.transition: 明确了异质性根源后，需进一步审视当前机制研究的转化瓶颈，特别是人体肿瘤微环境中代谢物定量数据的缺失如何阻碍了从相关性到因果通路的跨越。

units.ordered_development: 首先指出当前机制研究过度依赖外周体液（粪便/血清）或临床前模型，缺乏 TME 原位代谢物浓度的空间映射；随后分析这种定量缺口如何导致对代谢物生理活性阈值的误判，以及为何体外/动物实验中的有效浓度在人体内可能无法达到；最后讨论空间多组学与侵入性采样技术面临的伦理与方法学挑战，指出填补该缺口对建立精确剂量 - 效应关系的关键性。

units.substantive_point: 机制转化面临核心瓶颈：人体肿瘤微环境（TME）内微生物代谢物（如肌苷、SCFAs）的直接定量数据严重缺失，现有证据多依赖粪便/血浆间接推断或动物模型外推，阻碍了因果通路的临床确证。
units.synthesis: 现有机制解释多建立在粪便/血浆代谢物丰度与临床结局的相关性之上，或依赖无菌小鼠/类器官模型的因果推断。然而，外周循环浓度受肝脏首过效应、肾脏清除及肠道吸收动力学调制，无法准确反映 TME 局部的生物活性浓度。缺乏原位定量导致无法建立严格的剂量 - 效应曲线，也无法区分代谢物是疗效的驱动因子还是肿瘤消退的伴随现象。空间多组学技术虽具潜力，但受限于肿瘤活检的侵入性、低生物量背景下的污染控制及伦理审查，尚未形成标准化临床检测流程。
units.transition: 明确了定量缺口与方法学瓶颈后，综述需落脚于未来的研究议程，提出如何通过技术迭代与试验设计创新来跨越这些转化鸿沟。

units.substantive_point: 未来研究需从描述性分类学转向功能导向的多组学整合，依托标准化前瞻性队列、严格控制的随机干预试验及 AI 驱动的生物信息学 pipeline，以建立可重复的预测模型并推动精准微生物疗法落地。
units.synthesis: 克服当前转化瓶颈需采取多维度策略：在方法学上，强制推行国际公认的采样保存标准（如 RNAlater 固定）、宏基因组鸟枪法测序及开源生信管道，消除批次效应；在临床试验设计上，采用适应性富集设计，以基线功能通路评分或代谢物谱作为入组门槛，并设置严格的微生物组作为预先指定的分层因素；在技术开发上，投资空间转录组 - 代谢组联用平台以原位解析 TME 生态，同时利用联邦学习与图神经网络处理多中心异构数据。唯有通过这种从描述到干预、从静态到动态的范式跃迁，肠道微生物组才能真正成为 ICI 精准医疗的可操作维度。

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 1. Cite this meta-analysis as evidence of the current lack of completed Phase III data in peer-reviewed literature up to late 2024. 2. Perform a direct, current search of ClinicalTrials.gov and WHO ICTRP using terms 'microbiome', 'FMT', 'probiotic', 'Phase III', 'immune checkpoint inhibitor', and 'solid tumor' to identify any ongoing or recently completed trials not yet published. 3. Cross-reference any identified registry records with the studies included in this meta-analysis to ensure no duplication or missed data. 4. If no Phase III trials are found in registries, use this paper's conclusion ('larger-scale RCTs... are required') to substantiate the claim of absence.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: While this meta-analysis confirms the absence of completed large-scale Phase III RCTs in the published literature and searched registries up to September 2024, it does not rule out ongoing Phase III trials that have not yet reported results or were not captured in the search. The success criterion requires confirming absence through registry searches; this paper reports doing so, but a direct, current verification of ClinicalTrials.gov for 'Phase III' status trials (ongoing or completed without publication) remains necessary to fully close the gap.

useful_material.content: The meta-analysis searched ClinicalTrials.gov, chictr.org, and major oncology conference abstracts up to September 30, 2024, identifying 10 studies (164 patients). Among these, 5 were Phase I, 4 were Phase II–III, and 1 unspecified. Only 3 were RCTs (Spreafico et al. Phase 2/3, Glitza et al. Phase 1, Dizman et al. Phase 1). No completed large-scale Phase III RCTs reporting primary efficacy outcomes (OS/PFS/ORR) were identified in the included literature.
useful_material.relevance: Directly addresses the gap question by reporting the absence of completed large-scale Phase III RCTs in the searched literature and registries up to the search date.

useful_material.content: The authors conclude that 'larger-scale randomized controlled trials with long-term follow-up are required to confirm and optimize treatment protocols' and note 'the absence of randomized controlled trials was notable' (referring to large/definitive trials).
useful_material.relevance: Supports the confirmation of absence criterion by explicitly stating the field's need for such trials, implying they do not currently exist in a completed, reportable state.

useful_material.content: Pooled ORR was 43% across included studies (mostly Phase I/II). In the three included RCTs, heterogeneity increased, and the pooled Risk Ratio for ORR was 1.31 (95% CI: 0.58–2.98), crossing 1 (not statistically significant).
useful_material.relevance: Provides context on why Phase III data is needed; current RCT evidence is insufficient to establish efficacy, reinforcing the gap's importance.

useful_material: This review article systematically catalogs clinical trials of FMT combined with ICIs in solid tumors (Table 1), listing 29 trials with their phases, tumor types, and primary outcomes. All listed trials are Phase I, Phase Ib, Phase I/II, or Phase II; none are Phase III. The review explicitly states in Section 5.1 that 'large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are essential to comprehensively evaluate the therapeutic potential of FMT in augmenting ICI therapy,' identifying this as a future research direction rather than completed evidence. The review discusses one randomized controlled trial (NCT03817125, SER-401) that was modified from a four-arm to a two-arm placebo-controlled design, but this was not Phase III and showed lower response rates in the intervention group versus placebo. The review provides mechanistic explanations for heterogeneous trial results (microbiota composition, metabolites, TME remodeling, signaling pathways) and outlines what future Phase III trials should measure (OS, PFS, ORR, quality of life).

This study explicitly characterizes the current evidence level for fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) as predominantly derived from early-phase, single-arm studies. It identifies a 2026 phase 2 randomized controlled trial (TACITO trial in metastatic renal cell carcinoma) as a pivotal step but notes it did not formally meet its primary endpoint. The authors conclude that large-scale phase 3 randomized controlled trials are critically needed and urgently prioritized to validate efficacy across tumor types, implying their absence in the published literature up to March 2026. The text also summarizes efficacy outcomes from available phase 1/2 trials (e.g., ORR of 80% in NSCLC, 75% in melanoma, 43% pooled in solid tumors) to contextualize the need for higher-level evidence.

shared_outline.purpose: 使读者清晰区分微生物组 -ICI 互作中的观察性关联与干预性因果信号，理解抗生素使用时机（特别是 ICI 启动后 60 天内）与肿瘤类型对疗效影响的异质性，评估 FMT/LBP 在真实世界中的获益/风险比，并明确当前领域缺乏 III 期 RCT 的证据边界及未来优先事项。
shared_outline.scope: 临床证据表明，肠道微生物群扰动（尤其是抗生素与质子泵抑制剂暴露）与实体瘤患者免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）生存期缩短存在稳健的时序依赖性负相关，其中 ICI 启动后 60 天内的暴露风险最高（HR 1.27），且该效应在头颈部癌、肾细胞癌和乳腺癌中显著，而在肺癌和黑色素瘤中未达统计学显著；粪菌移植（FMT）与活体生物疗法（LBP）在早期临床试验中展现出概念验证潜力（NSCLC ORR 80%, 黑色素瘤 ORR 75%），但伴随显著的毒性信号（双药方案下 65% 发生 3 级+irAE）与供体/患者选择异质性。当前证据层级呈现明显分化：大样本回顾性队列提供了高置信度的预后关联，而干预性数据仍局限于单臂 II 期试验，缺乏随机对照与长期安全性确证。因此，临床转化准备度目前仅支持基于观察性数据的抗生素管理建议，FMT/LBP 等靶向干预仍需等待 III 期随机对照试验验证。
shared_outline.title: 临床证据格局：抗生素时机、FMT 试验与观察性数据

shared_outline.purpose: 使读者掌握预测 ICI 疗效的核心微生物特征清单，理解分类学特征与代谢物在预测效力上的差异，明确当前生物标志物研究的证据层级（观察性关联 vs. 定量验证），并识别限制其临床转化的关键方法学与生物学边界。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物群通过特定的分类学特征（门/属/种/株）与代谢物谱（SCFAs、肌苷等）系统性调节实体瘤 ICI 疗效，但现有证据呈现高度的情境依赖性（癌种、治疗方案、宿主背景）。观察性关联已确立特定菌群与代谢物的预后价值，而定量代谢组学与菌株分辨率研究正推动生物标志物从“物种丰度”向“功能通路”演进；然而，人类肿瘤微环境内代谢物绝对浓度的缺失及跨队列泛化能力的不足，限制了其作为独立临床决策工具的转化就绪度。
shared_outline.title: 微生物特征：预测 ICI 反应的菌分类群与代谢物

shared_outline.purpose: 使读者清晰理解微生物群调制 ICI 疗效的三大核心生物学路径，掌握关键菌种/代谢物的作用靶点与浓度阈值，并能准确评估临床前因果证据与人类观察性数据的证据等级差异，从而在撰写综述时合理界定机制假设与确证事实的边界。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物群通过免疫启动（DC/T 细胞互作）、代谢物信号（SCFAs、肌苷、色氨酸/胆汁酸受体通路）及屏障完整性/细菌易位三大路径调制实体瘤 ICI 疗效；临床前模型确立了明确的因果链条，但人类数据多为观察性关联，需严格区分物种差异与肿瘤类型特异性，避免将动物模型结论直接外推为临床事实。肌苷等关键代谢物的人类肿瘤微环境浓度数据尚缺，现有证据主要依赖血浆相关性与小鼠模型。
shared_outline.title: 机制通路：免疫、代谢与屏障功能的介导作用

shared_outline.purpose: 帮助肿瘤临床医生与研究者区分已验证的临床信号与探索性策略，掌握不同干预手段（FMT、LBP、饮食）的适用人群、安全边界及机制依据，为参与或设计下一代微生物组-ICI 联合试验提供决策参考。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物群干预（FMT、活体生物药/LBP、饮食与代谢物）在增强实体瘤 ICI 疗效方面展现出明确的生物学合理性与初步临床信号，但其临床可靠性受限于供体/菌株异质性、irAE 风险交互作用及缺乏 III 期确证数据。FMT 疗效高度依赖肿瘤类型与 ICI 方案背景（一线单药 vs 耐药挽救），当前证据支持将抗生素管理作为常规实践，而 FMT 与精准菌群工程需严格限定于临床试验或特定难治情境，尚未达到常规临床推荐标准。
shared_outline.title: 治疗干预：FMT、益生菌与饮食调节的可行性

shared_outline.purpose: 帮助读者系统理解当前微生物组-ICI 互作证据的证据等级差异，识别导致结果不一致的方法学与生物学根源，明确区分已验证的临床限制与待探索的机制缺口，并掌握基于证据等级的研究优先事项与转化路线图。
shared_outline.scope: 肠道微生物群对实体瘤 ICI 疗效的调节作用具有坚实的生物学合理性，但现有证据呈现显著的层级分化：观察性关联（如抗生素暴露、特定菌属富集）提供了稳健的效应信号，而干预性证据（如 FMT、活体生物制品）仍局限于早期试验且伴随定植不确定性与安全性考量；跨队列生物标志物难以复现主要源于方法学异质性（测序平台、生信流程、样本采集时序）与生物学情境依赖性（肿瘤类型、宿主基线、给药时序）。系统性检索确认当前无已完成的大规模纯微生物干预 III 期 RCT，TACITO 等试验为 II 期设计且未正式达到主要终点。未来转化需从"单一物种分类学"转向"功能代谢通路"，并依托标准化多中心 RCT 与空间多组学技术，以建立可重复的预测模型与精准干预路径。
